# SELECT 单主体或仅动作行为审计汇总

本文件仅收纳语句类别为 `SELECT` 且不含行为客体 `target` 的行为。

每条 SQL 只展示一次，随后逐行列出该语句类别下的行为；没有主体时只列语句动作。条目之间使用 `------` 分隔。

SQL 原文中的换行以 `\n` 显示；行为对象保持 fixture 中的 `TargetType(codeLine) resourcePath` 格式。
跨方言或版本完全相同的“语句类别 + SQL + 行为结果”只保留一次；SQL 相同但类别或行为不同的分别保留。

SQL  SELECT derived.bool_alias,COUNT(*) AS row_count,\n       MIN(derived.smallest),MAX(derived.largest)\nFROM (\n  SELECT bool_alias,\n         LEAST(tiny_signed,small_signed,medium_signed,int_signed,big_signed) AS smallest,\n         GREATEST(tiny_unsigned,small_unsigned,medium_unsigned,int_unsigned,big_unsigned) AS largest\n  FROM integer_lifecycle\n) AS derived\nGROUP BY derived.bool_alias\nORDER BY row_count DESC\nLIMIT 5;

SQL  SELECT DISTINCT\n       projects.project_id,\n       projects.project_name,\n       projects.client_ptr,\n       projects.comments,\n       SUM(budgets.amount_received) + SUM(budgets.adjustment) AS total_budget\nFROM join_crash_periods AS client_period,\n     join_crash_periods AS project_period,\n     join_crash_budgets AS budgets\nLEFT JOIN join_crash_projects AS projects\n  ON budgets.project_ptr = projects.project_id\n AND budgets.date_received <= '2001-03-22 14:15:09'\nLEFT JOIN join_crash_clients AS clients\n  ON clients.client_id = projects.client_ptr\nWHERE client_period.period_type = 'client_table'\n  AND client_period.period_key = clients.client_id\n  AND (client_period.start_date <= '2001-03-22 14:15:09' OR ISNULL(client_period.start_date))\n  AND (client_period.end_date > '2001-03-21 14:15:09' OR ISNULL(client_period.end_date))\n  AND project_period.period_type = 'project_table'\n  AND project_period.period_key = projects.project_id\n  AND (project_period.start_date <= '2001-03-22 14:15:09' OR ISNULL(project_period.start_date))\n  AND (project_period.end_date > '2001-03-21 14:15:09' OR ISNULL(project_period.end_date))\nGROUP BY clients.client_id,\n         projects.project_id,\n         client_period.period_id,\n         project_period.period_id\nORDER BY clients.client_name ASC,\n         projects.project_name ASC;

SQL  WITH RECURSIVE tree (id,parent_id,depth,path) AS (\n  SELECT id,parent_id,0,CAST(id AS CHAR(100)) FROM split80_recursive.nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL\n  UNION ALL\n  SELECT c.id,c.parent_id,p.depth+1,CONCAT(p.path,'/',c.id)\n  FROM split80_recursive.nodes AS c JOIN tree AS p ON c.parent_id=p.id\n  WHERE p.depth<5\n), scored AS (\n  SELECT id,parent_id,depth,path,\n         SUM(depth) OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_depth,\n         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM split80_recursive.nodes AS x\n          WHERE x.parent_id=tree.id\n            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM split80_recursive.nodes AS y WHERE y.id=x.id AND y.score>=x.score)) AS child_count\n  FROM tree\n)\nSELECT COALESCE(parent_id,-1) AS parent_key,\n       MAX(running_depth) AS max_running,\n       SUM(child_count) AS total_children,\n       CASE WHEN EXISTS (\n              SELECT 1 FROM scored AS s2\n              WHERE s2.parent_id <=> scored.parent_id AND s2.child_count>0\n            ) THEN 'branch' ELSE 'leaf' END AS kind\nFROM scored\nWHERE id IN (\n  SELECT n.id FROM split80_recursive.nodes AS n\n  WHERE n.id=scored.id OR n.parent_id=scored.id\n)\nGROUP BY parent_id\nHAVING SUM(child_count) >= (SELECT MIN(s3.child_count) FROM scored AS s3)\nUNION ALL\nSELECT -2,0,0,'sentinel'\nORDER BY parent_key\nLIMIT 10;
行为 CALL Function(2:24~2:28) /test/1/catalog1/schema1/CAST/
行为 READ Table(2:51~2:74) /test/1/catalog1/split80_recursive/nodes/
行为 CALL Function(4:36~4:42) /test/1/catalog1/schema1/CONCAT/
行为 CALL Function(9:9~9:12) /test/1/catalog1/schema1/SUM/
行为 CALL Function(10:17~10:22) /test/1/catalog1/schema1/COUNT/
行为 CALL Function(15:7~15:15) /test/1/catalog1/schema1/COALESCE/

SQL  WITH RECURSIVE tree (id,parent_id,depth,path) AS (\n  SELECT id,parent_id,0,CAST(id AS CHAR(100)) FROM split84_recursive.nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL\n  UNION ALL\n  SELECT c.id,c.parent_id,p.depth+1,CONCAT(p.path,'/',c.id)\n  FROM split84_recursive.nodes AS c JOIN tree AS p ON c.parent_id=p.id\n  WHERE p.depth<5\n), scored AS (\n  SELECT id,parent_id,depth,path,\n         SUM(depth) OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_depth,\n         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM split84_recursive.nodes AS x\n          WHERE x.parent_id=tree.id\n            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM split84_recursive.nodes AS y WHERE y.id=x.id AND y.score>=x.score)) AS child_count\n  FROM tree\n)\nSELECT COALESCE(parent_id,-1) AS parent_key,\n       MAX(running_depth) AS max_running,\n       SUM(child_count) AS total_children,\n       CASE WHEN EXISTS (\n              SELECT 1 FROM scored AS s2\n              WHERE s2.parent_id <=> scored.parent_id AND s2.child_count>0\n            ) THEN 'branch' ELSE 'leaf' END AS kind\nFROM scored\nWHERE id IN (\n  SELECT n.id FROM split84_recursive.nodes AS n\n  WHERE n.id=scored.id OR n.parent_id=scored.id\n)\nGROUP BY parent_id\nHAVING SUM(child_count) >= (SELECT MIN(s3.child_count) FROM scored AS s3)\nUNION ALL\nSELECT -2,0,0,'sentinel'\nORDER BY parent_key\nLIMIT 10;

SQL  WITH RECURSIVE tree (id,parent_id,depth,path) AS (\n  SELECT id,parent_id,0,CAST(id AS CHAR(100)) FROM split97_recursive.nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL\n  UNION ALL\n  SELECT c.id,c.parent_id,p.depth+1,CONCAT(p.path,'/',c.id)\n  FROM split97_recursive.nodes AS c JOIN tree AS p ON c.parent_id=p.id\n  WHERE p.depth<5\n), scored AS (\n  SELECT id,parent_id,depth,path,\n         SUM(depth) OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_depth,\n         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM split97_recursive.nodes AS x\n          WHERE x.parent_id=tree.id\n            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM split97_recursive.nodes AS y WHERE y.id=x.id AND y.score>=x.score)) AS child_count\n  FROM tree\n)\nSELECT COALESCE(parent_id,-1) AS parent_key,\n       MAX(running_depth) AS max_running,\n       SUM(child_count) AS total_children,\n       CASE WHEN EXISTS (\n              SELECT 1 FROM scored AS s2\n              WHERE s2.parent_id <=> scored.parent_id AND s2.child_count>0\n            ) THEN 'branch' ELSE 'leaf' END AS kind\nFROM scored\nWHERE id IN (\n  SELECT n.id FROM split97_recursive.nodes AS n\n  WHERE n.id=scored.id OR n.parent_id=scored.id\n)\nGROUP BY parent_id\nHAVING SUM(child_count) >= (SELECT MIN(s3.child_count) FROM scored AS s3)\nUNION ALL\nSELECT -2,0,0,'sentinel'\nORDER BY parent_key\nLIMIT 10;
